def count_students(image_path):
    """
    This function counts the number of students in front of a yellow schoolbus using Image Tool and python.
    """
    import tools

    # Load the trained model
    execution = tools.execute(tool_name="Object_Detector_Tool", image=image_path, labels=["student", "schoolbus"], threshold=0.35, model_size="tiny")

    # Get detected objects
    detection = [obj for obj in execution["output_type"] if obj["label"] == "student"]

    # Count the students
    count = len(detection)

    return count
